svg.text: When money is tight, people want
the state to step in. Almost everywhere.
The most economically vulnerable third says "government should take more responsibility"
more often than the most secure third in 62 of 87 countries. Reversed in 0.
Each column is a country, sorted by gap. Türkiye: +12.9 pp (47% vs 34%), rank 17 of 87.
Does a bad national economy make the gap bigger? No detectable link.
Each dot is a country. Height = its gap. Across = the economy around its survey year.
The divide tracks where a household stands, not where the national economy is.
Data: Joint EVS/WVS 2017–2022 · World Bank WDI (3-year average to survey year) · 95% bootstrap CIs · github.com/yigiterturk-dev/laya-wvs-sim
